correctness.evidence: Independent 0-1 MILP over all simple 6-cycle constraints gives optima 13,16,20 for n=7,8,9. For n=10, a complete maximum-degree split d=5..9 proves the target 22 infeasible; the explicit 21-edge witness closes the bound. Independent six-subset/cycle enumeration verifies all eight supplied n=7..14 witnesses are C6-free with the stated edge counts.

originality.evidence: Qualified to checked literature: He arXiv:2009.04590 gives asymptotic even-cycle bounds, not exact small-order values; Füredi-Simonovits arXiv:1306.5167 is a broad survey and no exact n=7..10 C6 table was located; Füredi-Naor-Verstraëte 2006 is dedicated to the hexagon Turán problem but its published abstract concerns asymptotic bounds. Exact-string and terminology searches did not locate prior values ex(7..10,C6) with witnesses.

value.evidence: Four consecutive exact values for a natural extremal invariant plus explicit witnesses are reusable as exact-search seeds, regression tests, and calibration points against asymptotic bounds. The n=11..14 claims remain explicitly one-sided lower bounds.
